comparison: Perfect agreement. Both evaluations find claims C1-C5 about asymmetric pit positioning and spatial patterning of cell behaviors to be well-supported. OpenEval cites Figure 1A and previous work; peer reviewers acknowledge this as fundamental context with no concerns raised.

Disagreement on evidence sufficiency. OpenEval finds claims C6-C8, C25-C29 about temporal dynamics and position-dependent behavior changes SUPPORTED by Figures 1B-E. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, requesting cell tracking analysis to unambiguously demonstrate that the same cells moved and changed behavior over time (Essential revision #3).

Agreement on core findings. Both evaluations find claims C16-C18, C32 about spatial/temporal patterns and dynamic adjustment of pre-patterned behavior to be SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers accept this as a key finding while requesting clarification of timing and cell tracking details.

Agreement on established findings. Both evaluations find claims C30-C31 about intercalation behavior SUPPORTED. OpenEval cites Figure 1G and previous work (Sanchez-Corrales et al., 2018); peer reviewers accept these as established foundation for the current study.

Partial overlap with different emphasis. OpenEval evaluates claims C33-C38 about myosin spatial/temporal patterns as SUPPORTED. Peer R4 addresses overlapping claims C34-C38 plus C39-C46, also rating SUPPORTED but requesting clarification on how myosin cycles are defined for cells far from the pit.

Agreement on myosin quantification. OpenEval finds claims C39-C46 about myosin intensity, cycle length, and strength differences SUPPORTED with statistical significance (p<0.0001). Peer reviewers also rate SUPPORTED, requesting clarification on definitions but not challenging the core findings.

Disagreement on mutant interpretation. OpenEval finds claims C9, C47-C50, C53, C62 about hkb mutant phenotypes SUPPORTED by Figures 3A-F and previous work. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, noting that complete loss of a transcription factor affects many cellular processes, not just actomyosin, and request experiments altering expression patterns (Essential revision #1).

Disagreement on mutant interpretation. OpenEval finds claims C51-C52, C54-C58 about constriction patterns in hkb mutants SUPPORTED by quantitative data in Figures 3G-J. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN due to concerns about pleiotropic effects of complete transcription factor loss and request additional controls.

Disagreement on mutant interpretation. OpenEval finds claims C59-C61, C63 about myosin patterns in hkb mutants SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, questioning whether the observed phenotypes specifically reflect actomyosin regulation or broader cellular effects of transcription factor loss.

Agreement on strain rate analysis. Both evaluations find claims C64-C72 about strain rate quantification and differences between wild-type and hkb mutants SUPPORTED. OpenEval cites statistical significance using mixed-effects models; peer reviewers note the analysis is complex but accept the findings as rigorous.

Agreement on intercalation analysis. Both evaluations find claims C73-C79 about neighbor gain analysis and intercalation patterns SUPPORTED. OpenEval cites statistical significance and multiple movies; peer reviewers accept the quantitative analysis despite noting complexity in presentation.

Agreement on cell elongation findings. Both evaluations find claims C80-C87 about cell elongation and intercalation signatures SUPPORTED. OpenEval notes C87 (Hkb involvement in pit specification) is appropriately stated as speculation; peer reviewers accept the data while requesting presentation simplification.

Disagreement on temporal relationships. OpenEval finds claims C88-C92, C97-C98 about Venus-Hkb expression patterns SUPPORTED by Figures 5A-F, 5M. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, requesting detailed discussion of timing since Fkh and Hkb expression patterns are offset by 30-60 min from Fog/myosin/constriction, questioning consistency with the proposed model.

Disagreement on temporal relationships. OpenEval finds claims C93-C96 about Fkh-GFP expression patterns SUPPORTED by Figures 5G-L, 5N. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, questioning whether the timing of transcription factor expression, transcription, translation, and secretion is consistent with the proposed model.

Disagreement on temporal correlations. OpenEval finds claims C99-C106 about temporal correlation between transcription factor peaks and apical area reduction SUPPORTED, noting the 30-40 min delay is consistent with molecular cascade timing. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, requesting clarification on whether timing is consistent with the model given the delays observed.

Agreement on speculative nature. Both evaluations recognize claim C107 (graded triggering of downstream targets) as speculation. OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN noting lack of direct causal evidence; peer reviewers rate the broader mechanism SUPPORTED but acknowledge the causal relationship is based on mutant analysis which they question elsewhere.

Agreement on background context. Both evaluations find claims C10-C15 about fkh mutant phenotypes and previous work SUPPORTED. OpenEval cites previous work and consistency with current data; peer reviewers accept this background material without challenge.

Agreement on established pathway. Both evaluations find claims C108-C112 about Fog dependence on Fkh and autocrine action SUPPORTED. OpenEval cites previous work and Figure 6Q-T; peer reviewers accept the correlation between transcription factors and Fog as a key finding.

Agreement on speculative claims. Both evaluations recognize claims C113-C114 (Fog upstream of constriction) as speculation. OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN noting lack of direct causal evidence; peer reviewers accept the mechanism as SUPPORTED but temper mechanistic certainty due to concerns about loss-of-function interpretation.

Disagreement on causality. OpenEval finds claims C115-C120 about Fog spatial/temporal patterns and correlations with apical area/myosin SUPPORTED by Figures 6A-L with quantified Pearson coefficients. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, questioning whether Fog accumulation is cause or effect, noting that apical constriction could concentrate apically secreted protein, and requesting determination of whether accumulation precedes constriction.

Disagreement on mutant interpretation. OpenEval finds claims C121-C125 about altered Fog pattern in hkb mutants SUPPORTED by Figures 6M-P with quantification from multiple embryos. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, questioning the interpretation due to pleiotropic effects of transcription factor loss and expressing confusion about how unchanged Fkh pattern could explain the delay observed in Hkb mutant.

Disagreement on mutant interpretation. OpenEval finds claims C126-C127 about loss of Fog enrichment in fkh mutants SUPPORTED by Figures 6Q-T. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, questioning whether the mutant phenotypes reflect specific effects on the proposed pathway or broader cellular disruptions.

Disagreement on mechanistic interpretation. OpenEval finds claims C128-C134 about Fog/myosin correlation in mutants and independence of Hkb/Fkh regulation SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, questioning the logic of how unchanged Fkh pattern could explain the Hkb mutant phenotype and expressing concern about pleiotropic effects.

Partial agreement on hierarchical model. OpenEval finds claims C135-C137 about the hierarchical relationship (Hkb/Fkh→Fog→myosin→behaviors) SUPPORTED by comprehensive analysis and previous work. Peer reviewers partially overlap, rating the interpretation UNCERTAIN due to concerns about mutant analysis limitations.

Disagreement on overexpression interpretation. OpenEval finds claims C138-C143 about Fog overexpression phenotype SUPPORTED by Figure 7 with statistical significance (p<0.0001). Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, requesting distinction between effects of excessive contractility in central cells versus expansion of domain size (Essential revision #2), and asking how endogenous Fog compares to Fkh-Gal4-driven Fog.

Partial agreement on geometric analysis. OpenEval finds claims C144-C147 about theoretical modeling and experimental validation of eccentric pit position SUPPORTED by Figures 7K-O. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN overall for the overexpression experiments but do not specifically challenge the geometric analysis itself.

Partial agreement on functional importance. OpenEval finds claims C148-C150 about malformed glands in hkb mutants and importance of eccentric pit SUPPORTED by Figure 3 supplement 2 and Figure 7 analysis. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN for the overexpression interpretation but accept the mutant phenotype as documented.

Agreement on overall model. Both evaluations find claims C151-C156 about transcription factor dynamics and position-specific behavior triggering SUPPORTED. OpenEval notes the interpretation is a reasonable inference from temporal/spatial correlations; peer reviewers accept this as the key contribution, stating the mechanism is likely generally important for tubular organ development.

Agreement on patterning interpretation. Both evaluations find claims C157-C161 about differential Hkb/Fkh expression defining eccentric pit SUPPORTED. OpenEval notes this is a reasonable inference from mutant phenotypes and expression patterns; peer reviewers accept the overall model as the key contribution despite concerns about specific experimental interpretations.

Agreement on upstream regulation context. Both evaluations find claims C162-C164 about Scr and Wg relationships SUPPORTED. OpenEval notes C164 is explicitly speculation about future work; peer reviewers accept this contextual information without challenge.

Agreement on background context. Both evaluations find claims C165-C168 about expression patterns of other proteins SUPPORTED by cited previous work. Peer reviewers do not challenge this background material.

Agreement on Fog signaling context. Both evaluations find claims C169-C172 about Fog signaling module and Hkb-binding site prediction SUPPORTED. OpenEval notes computational prediction is consistent with observed Hkb-dependence; peer reviewers accept this contextual information.

Agreement on GPCR discussion. Both evaluations find claims C173-C174 about Mist/Smog expression and unclear GPCR identity SUPPORTED. OpenEval notes honest acknowledgment of knowledge gap; peer reviewers do not challenge this discussion.

Agreement on comparative context. Both evaluations find claims C175-C180 about comparison with other morphogenetic mechanisms and transcriptional wave model SUPPORTED. OpenEval notes reasonable interpretation with cited support; peer reviewers accept this contextual discussion, only requesting simplification of dense writing.

Agreement on comparative discussion. Both evaluations find claim C181 about conserved asymmetric placodal setup SUPPORTED by cited previous work. Peer reviewers do not challenge this comparative context.
